changes: Use unchanged speech balloon outline from U+1F4AC; remove its ellipsis circles and black outline.
Reuse the original face path geometry from U+1F31A; translate the complete face by (0,-13) into the balloon and replace shading with solid colors.
Oiê lettering reused from the original hand-drawn vector studies, not a Noto font.
Chosen identity uses the flat balloon without shadows, gradient shading or cheek highlights.
Wordmark updated to Oiê, with uppercase O and a circumflex on ê. The lettering is drawn as vector paths.

brand.description: Oiê é uma saudação informal e amigável da língua portuguesa, usada para cumprimentar ou iniciar uma conversa com carinho e proximidade.
